versions.release_notes:
New Features and Improvements in Foxit PDF Reader 2026.2.0.39747
- Meet the newly enhanced Foxit AI Assistant - empower your work with intelligent Workspace and smarter interactions.
  - Introduce Foxit Workspace
    Create a project around your documents or a topic, then work with AI to review source materials, extract and organize information, draft content, and develop reusable and sharable outputs (including documents, images, presentations, mind maps, diagrams, infographics, web pages, and Markdown). Foxit Workspace transforms document-based work into a more connected process to help users complete real tasks, not just chat.
  - Enhanced AI Chat experience - The redesigned AI Assistant Chat has been upgraded from a standard Q&A interface to an Agent that can execute in cycles, maintain context, and invoke tools. Under this agent-based structure, previous tools listed in More tools and certain ribbon commands have been redesigned as skills or generation modes via Chat. The enhanced AI Chat also supports additional AI models, default connected apps (MCP connectors), and skills creation and management.
  - Support for Local AI with BYOM and SLMs - Provide strict data security by keeping document content within the user's environment while giving users control over which AI models run through custom models with Bring Your Own Model (BYOM) and enabling efficient on-device processing with SLMs.
  - Make document translation easier to control by letting users choose the pages to translate, choose Danish as a target language, and follow language-aware guidance during translation.
  - The redesigned Intelligent Reading has been separated into two standalone features, Read Aloud and Smart Podcast, providing a more streamlined way to explore, understand, and work with document content. The Read Aloud feature has been further improved to support reading selected text and highlighting the text currently being read.
- Add Arabic to the application interface for a more localized experience.
- Enhance Microsoft Purview Information Protection (MIP) support (Enterprise Packaging only)
  - Display the sensitivity labels that apply only to files, keeping the labeling experience focused.
  - Update the justification experience to ensure a complete, reliable audit trail for label changes.
  - Extend support to organizations using Azure Government Cloud (GCC High).
- Allow administrators to make enterprise-defined stamps available from a shared drive or local OneDrive folders so users always access the latest stamp set, with optional restrictions on end-user editing. All configurations can be managed through Foxit Customization Wizard or GPO settings.
- Improve certificate workflows by supporting the import of trusted certificates in CRT format and automatically recognizing timestamps embedded in certificates.
- Other enhancements to the user experience.

New Features and Improvements in Foxit PDF Reader 2026.1.0.36452
- New features and enhancements for AI Assistant
  - Provide an Action Inspector feature that analyzes JavaScript actions in documents when users open them, and promptly alerts users to potential risks if detected.
  - Add the Chats tab on the Start page of Foxit PDF Reader to help users easily manage their AI chat history for different documents.
- Add an option to hide the cursor while drawing with the Pencil tool on tablet type devices to enhance the stylus editing experience and resolve pressure sensitivity issues.
- Allow users to enable Overprint Preview for accurate rendering of overprint effects, ensuring correct visual output for print‑production PDFs.
- Support enterprise deployment through Foxit Customization Wizard or Group Policy, allowing administrators to enable the Foxit eSign feature to access the internet even when internet access is disabled for all other features.
- Other enhancements to the user experience.

New Features and Improvements in Foxit PDF Editor Subscription Release 2025.3.0.35737
- New features and enhancements for AI Assistant
  - Add AI powered image generation from text prompts or reference photos, and AI driven image editing inside PDFs.
  - Enable exporting AI Assistant responses, including summaries, reports, and insights, directly to Word or PDF.
  - Support additional languages for translations and AI responses.
  - Make Document Summary easier to access with a new ribbon button and panel, allowing users to extract key information without extra clicks.
- The enhanced Comment feature
  - Enable proper display and editing of comments generated by external PDF editors.
  - Easily create a CSV summary of your PDF comments with customizable columns, allowing you to select desired comment types, page ranges, and sorting options before export.
  - Add the ability to save custom annotations as favorites/templates in the Favorite Toolbox panel of the navigation pane for easy reuse.
- The Create Sequential Stamp feature automatically updates with sequential numbers or letters each time a stamp is applied, streamlining labeling for healthcare, legal, and version control workflows.
- Add settings to remove hidden information (including metadata, embedded content, and scripts) from PDFs before closing them or emailing them using the PDF Editor’s Email feature.
- Other enhancements to the user experience.

Improvements in Foxit PDF Reader 2025.1.0.27937
- Enhancements to AI Assistant
  - Foxit is transforming Reader with innovative AI-powered tools for intelligent document engagement. Discover the new features under the AI Assistant ribbon tab.
  - New smart tools have been added to enable users to read documents aloud with a wider range of voice options and to automatically create bookmarks based on document structures or page ranges.
  - You can now chat directly about the images you have uploaded.
  - More enhancements include the ability to analyze multiple documents simultaneously and an improved, streamlined process for document translation.

New Features and Improvements in Foxit PDF Reader 2023.3.0.23028
- Enhanced integration with ChatGPT to make end users more productive
  - Content Translation - Translating selected text into corresponding languages. Maximum 2000 characters per prompt, 50 prompts for free per user per day.
  - Document Q & A - Have a conversation with PDF and answer user questions based on PDF content. This service is free up to 50 prompts/questions per user per day.
  - Content Explanation - AI-powered feature that provides concise explanations and definitions for selected text.
  - Spelling and Grammar Correction - AI-powered feature that automatically detects and corrects spelling and grammar errors in your content.
  - More options are added to the existing AI features to help users better interact with the AI Assistant. Users can now specify tones (Formal, Professional, Funny, etc.) for text rewriting.
- Foxit AI Chatbot
  AI-powered customer support tool that utilizes natural language processing and machine learning algorithms to understand user queries and respond with answers. This is particularly useful for assisting users in using a specific function or performing certain tasks in Foxit PDF Reader by providing step-by-step instructions based on Foxit resources, such as Foxit Knowledge Base.
- Simplified eSign workflow (available in Foxit eSign Pro and Enterprise)
  - Maximize your document signing process by utilizing the bulk sending option to send a document to thousands of users simultaneously in just a few clicks.
  - Simplify the sending process by generating an online form from an existing template and distributing the online form via a link to users, allowing users to sign on any device connected to the internet.
  - Customize document branding by changing colors and adding logos to ensure and maintain your company’s brand continuity.
- Enhanced protection with sensitivity labels using Microsoft Azure Information Protection (MSI package only)
  - Support User Defined Permissions (UDP) Labels to let users assign permissions when they apply the sensitivity labels to PDF files, granting users the desired flexibility within the scope of organization’s security policies to improve the productivity.
  - Organization administrator can configure Default Labeling and Mandatory Labeling policies to apply a default label pre-set by the administrator or require users to add a sensitivity label when saving PDF files.
- Enhancements in PDF reviewing and commenting
  - Make or reply to comments on PDF files shared by Foxit PDF Editor in real time.
  - Rotate comments added by the Typewriter, Textbox, and Callout tools at any angle.
  - Optimize the display of floating toolbar for comments to improve the user experience.
- View, navigate, measure, and comment on 3D content in glTF (GL Transmission Format) format in PDF documents.
- Sign and verify digital signatures using the new Hash algorithms in compliance with ISO/TS 32001 and ISO/TS 32002.
- Improve the accessibility features associated with keyboard shortcuts, button identifiers, and object focus to deliver a better user experience.
Issues Addressed in Foxit PDF Reader 2023.3.0.23028
- Fixed some security and stability issues.

New Features and Improvements in Foxit PDF Reader 2023.2.0.21408
- Integration with ChatGPT to make end users more productive
  - Document Summaries - The OpenAI Summary service uses artificial intelligence to generate a concise and accurate summary of a given text input. It analyzes the content of the text and identifies the most important information to include in the summary, using natural language processing and machine learning algorithms.
  - Document Re-write - The OpenAI rewrite service uses machine learning to automatically paraphrase or rewrite text while maintaining its original meaning. This service is designed to help users generate new content from existing text, such as for content marketing, SEO, or simply to improve the clarity and readability of writing. This service is free up to 100 pages per user per month.
  - AI Chatbot– The OpenAI chatbot service uses natural language processing (NLP) to provide users with detailed responses to their questions in real-time. This service is free up to 50 prompts/questions per user per day.
- Customizable skin and the refreshed look of the title bar
  - Support the customization of the skin color to suit your preferences.
  - Thicken the title bar (sits at the top of the window) and adjust the positions of the items (such as the Search box and File Name) displayed on it, to provide a familiar and intuitive user interface similar to the style of Microsoft 365.
- Improve the Fill & Sign feature by allowing customizing the color of drawn/typed signatures and symbols (i.e., checkmarks/cross marks/dots).
- Bookmark enhancements
  - Search for bookmarks in PDFs using keywords to quickly find and navigate to the specific section.
  - Set the default zoom level for pages when creating bookmarks in PDFs.
  - Set and modify the appearances and actions of bookmarks in batch.
  - Provide the “Level Up” and “Level Down” options to move bookmarks one level up or down exactly, to avoid the clumsy manual dragging.
- Easier work with comments
  - Paste a comment at the same position on a different page as it is originally cut or copied from.
  - Add more options in the Commenting preferences and optimize the display scheme for the floating toolbar and pop-up note, to help users work easier with comments.
  - Rotate comments added by the Drawing tools at any angle.
- Measure the area of circular objects in PDF files.
- Use Microsoft Edge WebView2 to better display embedded web pages in the application.
Issues Addressed in Foxit PDF Reader 2023.2.0.21408
- Fixed an issue where the uploading of the .admx and .adml files on Intune failed.
- Fixed an issue where the application crash could occur when opening a digitally signed document from File Explorer with a PDF already open in the application.
- Fixed an issue where opening a certain file encrypted by File Open would result in an error prompt.
- Fixed an issue where the filled-in text was compressed and justified left when users filled in form fields in a certain PDF.
- Fixed some security and stability issues. Click here for details.
